raw_response:
I am already old, but I still look at the field carefully and I do not change things just for the sake of changing. On 6 mu, I cannot afford big mistakes. I have some schooling, so I do pay attention to rates and timing, but in the end I still trust what I have seen in Quzhou over many years. Wheat and maize are steady for grain and cash flow, and stevia is the crop that can bring a better return if the weather and buyer are okay, so this year I will still keep stevia as the main cash crop and leave a smaller area in wheat and maize. Water from the well helps, but pumping costs money, so I will irrigate at the key stages, not excessively. Fertilizer I will split rather than put all at once, because that is safer and uses money more efficiently. With only two people in the household, I also need the work schedule to be manageable.
